children: BOSTON, Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FirstService Residential, the leading residential community management company, is proud to announce that it has been selected to provide full-service property management for Battery Wharf Boston Master Condominium Association, one of Boston's most distinguished waterfront luxury communities.

Located along Boston Harbor, Battery Wharf is renowned for its exceptional location, world-class amenities, and unparalleled waterfront lifestyle. The community is a landmark destination where luxury, convenience, and hospitality converge in the heart of the city.

"We are thrilled to welcome Battery Wharf, one of Boston's true waterfront treasures, to the FirstService Residential family," said Michael Mendillo, President, East Region, FirstService Residential. "This extraordinary community sets a standard for luxury living, and we are honored to partner with the board to support its vision. Our team looks forward to delivering the specialized expertise, operational excellence, and personalized service."

The community continues to evolve with the addition of a premier fine dining restaurant and sophisticated hotel lounge. For boating enthusiasts, Battery Wharf offers exclusive opportunities for its residents to purchase private yacht docking rights, providing direct access to Boston Harbor. Residents also enjoy the convenience of an on-demand private water shuttle service to Logan International Airport, creating a seamless connection between home and travel.

"We were incredibly impressed by the board's thoughtful and comprehensive evaluation process," said Noushig Hagopian, Senior Vice President, FirstService Residential. "Their commitment to finding a collaborative management partner aligns perfectly with our philosophy of service and partnership. We look forward to bringing the full strength of FirstService Residential's resources, innovative solutions, and industry-leading expertise to support the association's goals and help ensure Battery Wharf continues to thrive as one of Boston's premier residential destinations."

As the leading residential community management company, FirstService Residential partners with boards and residents to protect and enhance property values, elevate resident lifestyles, and deliver customized solutions tailored to the unique needs of every community. Through local market expertise, proven operational excellence, and a steadfast commitment to service, FirstService Residential helps communities realize their vision today while creating lasting value for the future.

FirstService Residential is simplifying property management. Its hospitality-minded teams serve residential communities across the United States and Canada. The organization partners with boards, owners, and developers to enhance the value of every property and the life of every resident.

Leveraging unique expertise and scale, FirstService serves its clients with proven solutions and a service-first philosophy. Residents can count on 24/7 customer care and tailored lifestyle programming, amenity activation, and technology for their community's specific needs. Market-leading programs with FirstService Financial, FirstService Energy, and special districts teams deliver additional levels of support.
Boards and developers select FirstService Residential to realize their vision and drive positive change for residents in the communities in their trusted care.

), a North American leader in providing essential property services to a wide range of residential and commercial clients.
